name: Sleep
description: Slow, soft sketches for winding down and drifting off: warm pads, breathing tides, lullabies, firesides, snowfall and noise blankets. No drums, no sudden changes, and gentle levels throughout.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Drifting Off
sketches.description: A warm pad drifting through F major, a few soft keys that forget themselves now and then, and light rain.
sketches.source:
setcpm(50/4)

// A warm pad drifting through Fmaj7, Dm9, Bbmaj7 and C6
pad: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,e4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,a3]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .attack(2).release(4).lpf(900).room(.8).size(.95).gain(.14)

// A few soft keys, now and then
keys: n("<[4 ~ ~ 2] [~ 1 ~ ~] [0 ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ 2 ~]>").scale("F:major").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.3).seed("dream")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.01).decay(1.5).sustain(0).release(2)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.35).room(.7).gain(.2)

// A low root underneath
bass: note("<f2 d2 bb1 c2>").slow(2).s("sine").attack(1).release(3).gain(.22)

// Light rain on the roof
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.2).gain(.18)

sketches.name: Tide of Breath
sketches.description: Six breaths a minute: breathe in as the tone rises, out as it falls, while waves roll in.

sketches.name: Starlight Lullaby
sketches.description: A slow music-box waltz in G, a hummed line beneath it and crickets far away.

sketches.name: Hearthside
sketches.description: Slow guitar arpeggios in D by a crackling fire, a hummed tune and a quiet clock.

sketches.name: Delta Drift
sketches.description: Headphones on: a slow 2 Hz binaural drone, a dark pad that opens and closes, brown noise and distant bells.

sketches.name: Moonlit Lake
sketches.description: Scattered glass notes on still water, a low open fifth, a stream to the left and insects to the right.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// A low open fifth, barely there
drone: note("[d2,a2]").slow(4).s("sine").attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.17)

// Glass notes scattered on the water
glass: n(irand(5).segment(8)).scale("D:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.75).seed("lake")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(1).sustain(0).release(2)
  .pan(rand).delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.45).room(.7).gain(.14)

// A stream on the left, insects on the right
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(-60).distance(4).gain(.2)
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(80).distance(5).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Snowfall
sketches.description: A hushed choir in E minor, soft wind at the window and high bells falling like snowflakes.
sketches.source:
setcpm(46/4)

// Wind at the window
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.13)

// A hushed choir: Em, C, Am, B
choir: note("<[e3,g3,b3] [c3,e3,g3] [a2,c3,e3] [b2,d#3,f#3]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<oo oo ah oo>")
  .attack(2).release(3).space("hall").gain(.2)

// A low root beneath the choir
bass: note("<e2 c2 a1 b1>").slow(2).s("sine").attack(2).release(4).gain(.18)

// Snowflakes: high bells, a few at a time
flakes: note("<[b5 ~ g5 ~] [~ e5 ~ ~] [~ ~ f#5 ~] [d#5 ~ ~ ~]>")
  .degradeBy(.25).seed("snow")
  .s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.76).decay(2).sustain(0).release(2)
  .pan(rand).space("hall").gain(.07)

sketches.name: Brown Noise Blanket
sketches.description: A deep, steady blanket of filtered brown noise with a soft hum underneath, for masking the world and sleeping through.
